_comment: Sample RPM artifact manifest. The hash here would be filled by the build pipeline via `rpm -qp --queryformat '%{SIGSHA256}' nginx-*.rpm` or `dnf repoquery --location --queryformat=...`. Placeholder until first build.
name: nginx

metadata.note: dnf already verifies the GPG signature; the sha256 in this manifest adds a second layer that binds the install to a specific M-of-N-approved hash. If Amazon Linux ships a new build of the same version with a different sha256 (rebuild for a security patch, say), the manifest must be re-signed before this Safebox will install it.
